scope: Real Prune Context Engine packing over a fixed JSONL task set; no LLM patch generation and no SWE-bench test execution.
question: Does the E115-style sparse rotating causal sensor improve closed-loop selection of real Prune strategy mutations over an outcome-history-only policy at equal deployment generations?

substrate.task_format: Prune eval JSONL with task/prompt plus expect_paths and optional expect_symbols
substrate.task_partition: deterministic hash partition into train/probe/evaluation; probe and evaluation are disjoint
substrate.base_strategy: caller-supplied JSON/TOML StrategyConfig or Prune defaults

utility.token_efficiency_reference: budget_tokens if supplied, otherwise max observed pack tokens within the evaluated candidate pool
utility.note: Utility is used only for this methodology experiment. Raw component metrics are always reported separately.

closed_loop.raw_policy: ridge pairwise ranker over [x, delta, x*delta], trained only on train-task outcomes from previously evaluated strategies
closed_loop.sparse_causal_policy: same raw ranker; when raw top1-top2 margin is below a calibration threshold, evaluate the raw top-4 siblings on one rotating probe shard and rerank using measured directional response
closed_loop.probe_rotation: one of 8 deterministic probe shards per generation

primary_metric: evaluation-task utility gain of final strategy versus common starting strategy after 12 generations

decision_rule.SPARSE_CAUSAL_PRUNE_PROMISING: causal final evaluation utility >= raw + 0.01 and causal probe pack evaluations <= 0.35 * full-top4-all-probe-shards equivalent
decision_rule.SPARSE_CAUSAL_PRUNE_WEAK_SIGNAL: causal final evaluation utility > raw and causal probe pack evaluations <= 0.35 * full-top4-all-probe-shards equivalent

anti_leakage: evaluation tasks are never used for candidate selection, ranker fitting, gate calibration or causal probes
probe tasks are never used as raw-ranker labels
task partitions are fixed before strategy search
candidate mutation schedules are identical between raw and causal policies
the final evaluation compares policies from the same starting StrategyConfig
claim_boundary: A positive result would establish only that sparse causal sensing improves Prune strategy search on the selected task set. It would not establish LLM recursive self-improvement or end-to-end SWE-bench resolution gains.
next_if_positive: Run the winning search policy on SWE-bench Multilingual Stage A across Rust and TypeScript repositories, then promote only frozen finalists to Stage B harness evaluation.
